agera5_v2.notes: AgERA5 v2 remains the active daily-updated version; v1/v1.1 are superseded.

era5_land.notes: Use for land/soil-water history; not station observation.

credential_policy: CDS credentials are injected by secret/environment only
licence acceptance is external account state and must be verified before retrieval
crosscheck_gate: pair station and gridded data by date/metric
calculate mean bias, MAE, RMSE and correlation
do not overwrite raw gridded values with station corrections without versioned methodology
